visualCharacteristics.structure: row-label column (program link, sub-label, optional 'Now stackable' pill) + grouped value columns ('At the pump': Premium gas / All other fuels, 'In-store': Purchase) with icon group headers; each value tile = large value + small caption; last row = totals (dark tile, '+ Special offers' pill link)
visualCharacteristics.notes: Source div.ibo-chart-desktop on /en/rewards/frequent-filler (ibo-chart-mobile duplicates it and is ignored). Column colours (blue premium, pale blue other fuels, grey in-store) are for the design pass and key off table-benefits-col-N classes.

contentPattern: N rows x up to 4 cells. Row 1 header: [corner label] | [icon, group title, group sub-label, column label] | [column label] | [icon, group title, group sub-label, column label]. Rows 2..n: [optional pill p, program link p, sub-label p] | [value p, caption p] x3 (cells may be empty). Last row = totals unless no-total.
reuseGuidance: Use for the Rewards+ benefits stacking chart (source .ibo-chart-desktop) and similar programs-vs-benefits comparison charts with up to 3 value columns. Not for body-copy data tables (use table).
